changes: Adapts the existing attributed A16 candidate packed uint2 loads, two output rows per warp, and T2/3 shared activation staging.

Restores the frozen TensorSharp ts_ni_project_a16 arithmetic: one positive-zero initialized accumulator, groups lane+32*phase, K order 0,8,1,9,...7,15, scale*inverseD then code*coefficient before fmaf.
Restores the exact legacy XOR warp sum at distances16,8,4,2,1 and publishes the accumulator directly without an extra zero add.

Replaces only scalar FP4 table lookups with CUDA FP4x2-to-float2 conversion of each unmodified TS code byte. Low/high multiplication and FMA order, signed zeros, scalar E4M3 conversion and all BF16 boundaries remain unchanged.
Separate fixed-K5120/6144/17408 and T1/2/3 driver entries; explicit row tails and input/output strides; no PDL contract.
The original-Ignis-schedule candidate remains unchanged and separately identifiable.

Separate native file/image from the measured scalar exact-legacy candidate; same driver symbols and arithmetic policy permit unchanged strict component/timing tools with separately matching image certificates.
acceptance: Unvalidated scheduling candidate. Requires bitwise candidateGPU==frozenLegacyGPU==independentCPU across fixed components, original fixed FP64 bounds, guards/immutability/replay, then complete model and end-to-end quality/performance gates; no default adoption.
